# Nutanix Provider

Nutanix infrastructure provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nutanix = {
      source = "ioplane/nutanix"
    }
  }
}

provider "nutanix" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Nutanix API key. May be set with NUTANIX_API_KEY.
- `ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM CA bundle appended to system roots. May be set with NUTANIX_CA_CERTIFICATE.
- `endpoint` (String) HTTPS origin of one Nutanix control plane. May be set with NUTANIX_ENDPOINT.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification. May be set with NUTANIX_INSECURE; defaults to false.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Basic authentication password. May be set with NUTANIX_PASSWORD.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) Per-attempt HTTP timeout in seconds. May be set with NUTANIX_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; defaults to 60.
- `username` (String) Basic authentication username. May be set with NUTANIX_USERNAME.
